Tailwind Takeoff.name: Tailwind Takeoff
Tailwind Takeoff.description: The user spreads their wings and a pocket of wind forms under the primary feathers, lifting them in a single beat onto a low roof, across a narrow street or clear of an incoming attack, which misses them. It reaches half the height of a full wing launch, the user must land by the end of their turn, and soaked or pinned feathers cannot catch the draft. Strain: light.
